channel.title: AI Unfiltered
channel.description: Chinese AI • Open Source • Security • Incidents. Signal, not noise.

item.title: CISO Conversations: James Robinson – Many Jobs, One Journey to Netskope CISO
item.description: James Robinson never planned a cybersecurity career — seven companies and one deputy CISO role later, he leads security at Netskope. The post CISO Conversations: James Robinson – Many Jobs, One Journey to Netskope CISO appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Alibaba's QwenWork Opens Invite Beta for an E-Commerce Edition Built for Multi-Platform Sellers
item.description: QwenWork's e-commerce edition adds a cross-platform operations dashboard, trend and selling-point analysis and batch content generation. It cannot yet run ad campaigns or take over stores.

item.title: Inspire Robots Launches RH37D1, a Direct-Drive Three-Finger Hand That Lifts Up to 43kg
item.description: Inspire Robots introduced the RH37D1 series at CIIF 2026: a fully direct-drive three-finger hand with seven active degrees of freedom, 40N fingertip force and a 43kg maximum pulling load.

item.title: Inovance Debuts InoBot W1, a Liquid-Cooled Wheeled Humanoid Built for Factory Shifts
item.description: Industrial automation maker Inovance showed its first humanoid, the wheeled InoBot W1, with liquid-cooled 2,070 TOPS compute, a 10-hour hot-swappable battery and a footprint under 0.6m square.

item.title: Langdao Silex Shows an EUV Light Source Prototype, Says Mass Production Is Three to Five Years Away
item.description: Shanghai-based Langdao Silex displayed an LPP extreme ultraviolet light source prototype at CIIF 2026. Its low-power system delivers over 15W, far below the hundreds of watts lithography needs.

item.title: Mathematicians Use Shanghai AI Lab's Intern-S2 to Prove 3D Ghys Conjecture, Verified in Lean
item.description: A proof of the codimension-one case of a 1995 conjecture by Etienne Ghys was developed with Intern-S2 over many rounds of dialogue, and a Peking University team formalized it in Lean.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Zero-Day Exploited for Remote Code Execution
item.description: The company says it’s aware of limited exploitation against customers’ firewalls, and it has made IoCs available. The post Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Zero-Day Exploited for Remote Code Execution appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Cisco Warns of Exploited Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability
item.description: Unauthenticated, remote attackers could write arbitrary files to the operating system and execute commands with root privileges. The post Cisco Warns of Exploited Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability appeared first on SecurityWeek.
